SELECT s.region, s.store_id IS NOT NULL, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, min(s.valid_from), max(s.valid_to), min(s.store_id), max(s.store_id)
FROM dim_store s GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.vat_rate, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN f.gross_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullgross, sum(f.gross_amount) g, sum(f.net_amount) n_, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'dup_line_id' k, count(*) - count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) v FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'

UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_wb', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31'

UNION ALL SELECT 'null_prod_join', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product s ON s.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.product_key IS NULL AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31'

SELECT o.status, count(*) n, min(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) mino, max(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) maxo, min(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) mind, max(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) maxd
FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.order_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2024-07-15' AND TIMESTAMP '2024-10-15' GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date,
           s.region, s.store_id, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount, (s.store_id=900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL) AS web_unmatched
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT region,
  sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) aug_gross,
  sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) sep_gross,
  sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN net_amount END) aug_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN net_amount END) sep_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN web_unmatched THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unmatched
FROM lines GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
mine AS (
    SELECT s.store_id, CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS d, sum(f.net_amount) n
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
m2 AS (SELECT store_id, sum(n) n FROM mine WHERE d BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) n FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(m2.store_id, r.store_id) sid, m2.n mine, r.n rpt, round(coalesce(m2.n,0)-coalesce(r.n,0),2) diff
FROM m2 FULL JOIN r ON r.store_id = m2.store_id
WHERE abs(coalesce(m2.n,0)-coalesce(r.n,0)) > 0.01 ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS from_sep, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 OR f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT s.region, s.store_id, count(DISTINCT s.store_key) versions, min(s.valid_from), max(s.valid_to)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id IN (101,102,103,104,105,114,900) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date,
           s.region, f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024_gross_incl_vat,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024_gross_incl_vat
FROM lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region
